diagram-definition.user-facing-description: A compact workflow for handling a production issue from report through release.
diagram-definition.development-scope-and-focus: Track the basic incident response path across intake, triage, diagnosis, implementation, review, and release. Keep the diagram intentionally small so tests can focus on simple topology changes.

lucid-flyway.description: Created a small incident response workflow with six nodes. The flow moves from an incoming report through triage, diagnosis, fix development, review, and release.
lucid-flyway.topology-changes: C^flowchart TD C^report[Issue reported] C^triage[Triage issue] C^diagnose[Diagnose cause] C^fix[Implement fix] C^review[Review change] C^release[Release patch] C^report --> triage C^triage --> diagnose C^diagnose --> fix C^fix --> review C^review --> release
